coverage.regulatory: Independent UK MHRA and EU EMA primary records acquired and hashed.
coverage.clinical_trials: ClinicalTrials.gov intervention search enumerated 13 records; pivotal NCT03860935 acquired separately with results metadata.
coverage.price: NICE confirms that the acoramidis price used by the resource model is confidential; no public attributable list or net price was found in these primary records. NHSBSA indicative aggregate cost remains a distinct administrative field.
coverage.commercial: SEC issuer identity/latest filing index and BridgeBio/Bayer public commercial-rights disclosure acquired; confidential agreement schedules and NHS-specific commercial terms remain unavailable.
coverage.procurement: Both UK central procurement search services were probed and hashed, but the server-rendered responses did not verify the query or expose an attributable notice; absence is not inferred.
coverage.triangulation: MHRA authorisation date/holder and EMA authorisation/product identity independently corroborate the regulatory context. ClinicalTrials.gov supports the pivotal study identity and enrollment. Company disclosures are secondary to regulator records and do not establish reimbursement.

negative_or_deferred.reason: NICE explicitly requires users to input the confidential price; no attributable public UK list/net price was established.
negative_or_deferred.retry_condition: An authoritative public price notice or explicitly redistributable NHS/manufacturer source is published.

negative_or_deferred.reason: Search responses were retrievable and hashed but did not reflect the keyword in returned HTML; a zero-result claim would be unsafe.
negative_or_deferred.retry_condition: A documented API/export or interactive result supplies an attributable query and result count.

negative_or_deferred.reason: SEC submissions metadata identified accession 0001743881-26-000009, but the filing payload request returned HTTP 403; metadata remains usable, payload was not bypassed.
negative_or_deferred.retry_condition: SEC permits a compliant bounded retrieval or an issuer-hosted immutable copy is available.

negative_or_deferred.reason: Regulatory, trial, corporate, and procurement-discovery records do not identify a displaced programme or confidential NHS transaction price.
negative_or_deferred.retry_condition: An attributable authorised NHS decision packet provides those fields.

rights_boundary.discovery: all listed public records were inventoried irrespective of ultimate reuse status
rights_boundary.retention: no source payload committed; hashes and narrowly derived factual metadata only
rights_boundary.use: OGL/API fields may support attributed research context; EMA, NICE, issuer, and SEC material remains citation-only unless separately adjudicated
rights_boundary.promotion: empirical, payer, HTA, policy, regulatory, calibrated, raw-data, and confidential-data claims remain disabled

checks: direct byte counts and SHA-256 captured
ClinicalTrials.gov query and pivotal record independently hashed
procurement response not misreported as zero results
limitations: public accessibility does not resolve every source-specific reuse right
company statements are not independent regulatory or reimbursement evidence
trial registry content is submitted record data
procurement searches require a query-verifiable route before absence can be asserted
